title: 페이스메이커
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop, J-Rock, high-energy pop-rock. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted power chords in the verses and open, ringing chords in the chorus. A slap bass technique is used during the pre-chorus. Drums feature a driving 4/4 beat with prominent crash cymbals on transitions. Synthesizer leads provide melodic counterpoints with a bright, sawtooth-wave timbre. Male vocals are delivered in a powerful tenor range with occasional layered harmonies. Key of B Major. Tempo 165 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[bright synth lead, distorted electric guitar power chords, driving drums]
(Hoo!)

[palm-muted electric guitar, bass guitar, steady kick drum]
